Name: Raffadax Bundles
Author: LoudCatNoise
Description:
This mod adds new bundles for the Community Center with items from Raffadax Complete production. The bundles appear in the main room of the Community center after completing four other bundles.

[code][spoiler]The final reward comes in mail after you complete the Community Center.[/spoiler]
[/code]
Installation;
1. Download the dependencies.
2. Download this mod
3. Drop the unpacked files into the mods folder.

Some sprites on the attached pictures are from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13661]Retexture[/url]﻿ for Raffadax.

Notes & Compatibility:
This mod doesn't interfere with any mods that edit vanilla bundles. You can install it at any point in the game until you have finished the Community Center.
